title: Auto-Growing Textarea
description: A chat composer where an Input rendered as a textarea grows with $fitContent inside an InputGroup that draws the edge, with a send Button in an InputSlot. Enter submits the form, Shift+Enter adds a line, Enter during IME composition is ignored, and empty drafts are skipped. Use it for chat or comment inputs that auto-grow and send on Enter, rather than the fixed-height textarea in Controls.
